cat > catalog.py <<'EOF'
import argparse
import json
from pathlib import Path


def search_key(title):
    return title.casefold()


def load(path="data/books.json"):
    return json.loads(Path(path).read_text())


def build_export(rows):
    """Search export: every row (inactive included), original title kept, sorted deterministically."""
    books = [{"isbn": r["isbn"], "edition": r["edition"], "title": r["title"],
              "active": r["active"], "key": search_key(r["title"])} for r in rows]
    books.sort(key=lambda b: (b["key"], b["isbn"], b["edition"]))
    return {"books": books}


def write_export(rows, path):
    path = Path(path)
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(json.dumps(build_export(rows), ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")


def search(books, prefix):
    needle = search_key(prefix)
    return [b for b in books if b["key"].startswith(needle)]


def main(argv=None):
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    sub = ap.add_subparsers(dest="cmd")
    b = sub.add_parser("build", help="write the search export")
    b.add_argument("--source", default="data/books.json")
    b.add_argument("--out", default="build/search.json")
    s = sub.add_parser("search", help="prefix search an export")
    s.add_argument("prefix")
    s.add_argument("--export", default="build/search.json")
    args = ap.parse_args(argv)
    if args.cmd == "build":
        write_export(load(args.source), args.out)
    elif args.cmd == "search":
        books = json.loads(Path(args.export).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))["books"]
        for r in search(books, args.prefix):
            print(f'{r["isbn"]}\t{r["edition"]}\t{r["title"]}\t{"active" if r["active"] else "inactive"}')
    else:
        rows = load()
        print(json.dumps({"rows": len(rows), "unique_isbns": len({r["isbn"] for r in rows}),
                          "keys": [search_key(r["title"]) for r in rows]}, ensure_ascii=False))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
EOF
cat >> tests/test_catalog.py <<'EOF'


def test_export_keeps_editions_inactive_titles_and_expanded_keys():
    from catalog import build_export
    books = build_export(load())["books"]
    assert len(books) == 4
    assert [b["active"] for b in books].count(False) == 1
    strasse = [b for b in books if b["title"] == "Straße Atlas"]
    assert {b["edition"] for b in strasse} == {"paper", "large-print"}
    assert all(b["key"] == "strasse atlas" and len(b["key"]) != len(b["title"]) for b in strasse)
    assert [(b["key"], b["isbn"], b["edition"]) for b in books] == sorted((b["key"], b["isbn"], b["edition"]) for b in books)


def test_prefix_search_uses_folded_query():
    from catalog import build_export, search
    books = build_export(load())["books"]
    assert len(search(books, "stras")) == 2
    assert len(search(books, "STRAßE")) == 2
    assert [b["title"] for b in search(books, "APP")] == ["apple Almanac"]
    assert search(books, "zeb")[0]["active"] is False
EOF
